# LookLens — Design Notes

Source: ColorLib The Look (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/thelook/)
Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/thelook/
New name: looklens

## Structure Order

1. Navbar (fixed, nav links)
2. Hero Slider (3 slides, auto-play, dark overlay)
3. Gallery (quote + 6 portfolio items in grid)
4. Blog (2 article cards)
5. Contact Form + Footer

## Section-by-Section Fidelity Notes

### Navbar
- Fixed top navigation bar
- Links: Home, Gallery, Artists, Shop, News, Contact
- Dark background (#081624) matching page
- Clean, minimal styling

### Hero Slider
- Full-width carousel with 3 slides
- Each slide: "The Look Gallery" heading, "John Doe" artist name
- "Showcase 23 January - 14 February" date subtitle
- "Read More" CTA button
- Dark overlay on background images
- Auto-advance carousel

### Gallery
- Opening quote: "The camera makes you forget you're there..."
- 6 portfolio items in a responsive grid (3-column desktop)
- Each item: image, "Red Passion 2017" title, "Artist: John Doe" label
- "view gallery" link on each item
- Hover overlay effect with title/artist

### Blog
- Heading: "Latest from the blog"
- 2 blog cards side by side
- Each card: "photography" category tag, title, date, excerpt text
- "Read More" link on each card

### Contact/Footer
- "Get in touch" heading
- Message textarea input
- "send message" button
- Copyright notice
- "Made with Component Dock" branding

## Design Token Summary

- Primary dark: #081624 (near-black navy)
- White: #fff (text on dark)
- Body font: Lato (sans-serif)
- Button style: pill-shaped (border-radius: 60px)
- Overall: monochrome dark palette, minimal, clean
